title: What Is a Hash Function? SHA-256 Explained in 20 Seconds
description:
A hash function turns any input into a fixed-size digest (256 bits for SHA-256), and changing one character changes the digest drastically: the avalanche effect.

The book and 4 GB file rows are stand-in bytes and the avalanche grid is decorative; the hello/hellp digests are real SHA-256 values.

No remixed repo; built with HyperFrames (HeyGen) and GSAP.

Narration is a synthetic voice (VoiceStudio). Animation is written as code.
